column1: # The recharge order this mod patches, one line per list slot:
#   FILE<TAB>ENTRY<TAB>INDEX<TAB>BASE<TAB>VALUE<TAB>SCOPE
# FILE is the MBIN path the game uses, relative to the data root.
# ENTRY is the _id of the GcTechnology row.
# INDEX is the slot in that row's ChargeBy list.
# BASE is the value the game ships in that slot today, or empty when the
#   game ships no slot there at all: TERRAINEDITOR's list starts empty and
#   the mod writes it, rather than reordering it.
# VALUE is the value the mod puts there.
# SCOPE tags which installer options carry the row: suit rows ship in the
#   full and suit-only variants, terrain rows in the full and
#   terrain-only variants.
# Every slot of every patched list is listed, including the slots that do
# not move. The render step turns this table into one whole-list rewrite
# per technology, and verify checks every slot and the list length, so a
# list can never ship half patched.
# ChargeBy is the game's recharge order: the first fuel it can find is the
# one it spends, and the rest are fallbacks. These rows move the crafted
# consumables to the front and leave the raw substances behind them.
#   ENERGY      Life Support        Life Support Gel, Oxygen, Dioxite
#   PROTECT     Hazard Protection   Ion Battery, Sodium, Sodium Nitrate
#   T_RAD       Radiation shield    Ion Battery, Uranium
#   T_TOX       Toxic shield        Ion Battery, Ammonia
#   T_COLDPROT  Cold shield         Ion Battery, Dioxite
#   T_HOTPROT   Heat shield         Ion Battery, Phosphorus
#   T_UNW       Underwater shield   Life Support Gel, Oxygen
#   TERRAINEDITOR Terrain Manipulator Silicate Powder, Ferrite Dust, Pure Ferrite, Magnetised Ferrite
